Duplication Quirk.name: Duplication Quirk
Duplication Quirk.description:
👥 You make living doubles of yourself.

🌱 At the start you split off up to two doubles in about a second; they think, talk and fight as you do, wear copies of your clothes, and burst harmlessly when hit hard.
📈 With training: a guard double, a spare self working for hours, stacks over walls, hiding among yourselves, search crews, a pinned giant, a flooded street, doubled allies.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Stamina Drain, as every double is built from your own energy.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Twice (Double).

📈 Grants: Intelligence +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Team Coordination +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Splitting Image, Fall Guy
Duplication Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: the user makes self-acting doubles. At first: up to two at a time, each appearing within arm's reach in about a second, wearing copied clothes and gear; they share the user's body, skills and memories up to their making and follow the user's lead for the scene, about ten minutes at most. More needs learned techniques. Limits: doubles burst into a harmless puff when cut, burned or hit hard, and cannot use the Quirk. Copied gear is a dead shell that vanishes with them (phones, keys, weapons, money do nothing). The user feels where each bursts. Doubling anyone else needs a learned technique. Quirk Strain: light: a double or two, a guard; moderate: lasting spare, boost, crowd to hide in; heavy: rescue crew, dogpile; severe: signature swarm, doubling a team. Type: Emitter. Law: a double's acts are the user's own Quirk use and crimes; doubles faking an alibi or sitting exams are fraud. Look: doubles peel off and burst in a shimmer of the player's chosen color.
